independence_evidence: Published by Outburst Arts, the Belfast queer arts organisation that runs the Outburst Queer Arts Festival ('catflap is the annual publication of new queer writing from Outburst Arts'); an arts charity, not a media group.
qualifies_reason: Annual print-only queer writing journal from a Belfast arts organisation, with issue 5 released in late 2025 and issue 6 announced for the November 2026 festival.
what_it_is: catflap is an annual print-only journal of new queer writing from Belfast: essays from the polemical to the speculative, poetry written for page and stage, and curated interviews, mixing pop culture with queer theory in a deliberately playful register. Each issue is edited with a guest editor and drawn partly from an open call. It suits readers of literary magazines and queer culture titles rather than news-driven LGBTQ press.

cover_candidates.notes: Stockist (rile* books, Brussels) listing image of Issue 05; flat cover but only 750px wide.
Public Knowledge Books (the title's distributor) product photo; landscape format, so probably a styled photograph of the magazine rather than a flat cover.

uncertainties: The publisher's own shop runs on Ticketsolve and renders only by script, so no publisher price could be read (distributor Public Knowledge Books lists Issue 05 at GBP 12, rile* books at EUR 16). The Issue 5 date is taken from the distributor listing it on 2025-12-12 and the publisher's statement that issues launch at its November festival; no exact date was found. The open-call page says catflap #6 'will be launched with a special event as part of Outburst Queer Art Festival 2026, November 13-21' (edited by So Mayer); as of 2026-11-19 no listing of #6 was found, so #5 is recorded as the latest issue out. The queer-led tag rests on Outburst Arts describing itself as a queer arts organisation publishing 'smart new queer writing'. Page count and trim size not on the publisher's site (magCulture gives 190 x 250 mm, 90 pages for issue 4).
